about_the_game:
Welcome to Pixel Empires, a handcrafted pixel-art RTS that puts you in command of a fledgling medieval realm. From humble homesteads to sprawling fortresses, you’ll design and optimize every aspect of your empire—whether you’re planting crops, automating your gold mines, or leading armored legions into battle.

Key Features:

Pixel-Perfect Top-Down View
Experience a nostalgic pixel-art world with crisp visuals and a clear strategic overview.

Deep Base Building & Automation
Lay out farms, sawmills, and gold mines—then set up conveyor belts and AI laborers to run them for you.

Tactical Real-Time Combat
Command squads on a grid-based battlefield. Use formations, terrain, and timing to outmaneuver foes.

Exploration & Expansion
Scout surrounding wilderness, uncover hidden resources, and secure new territories to fuel your growth.

Single-Player Campaign
Follow a rich narrative of dynastic ambition, complete with escalating challenges and diverse mission objectives.

Customizable AI & Automation Settings
Adjust worker priorities, toggle auto-gather modes, and fine-tune your economy to suit any playstyle.

Retro Indie Vibes
Immerse yourself in atmospheric chiptune soundscapes and a lovingly crafted pixel world.

Whether you’re managing granular logistics or rallying troops for a decisive siege, Pixel Empires offers a satisfying blend of strategy, automation, and exploration. Forge your dynasty—one pixel at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Broadband internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560

short_description: Pixel Empires is a pixel-art real-time strategy game where you build and manage medieval colonies, automate resource gathering with intuitive AI, explore uncharted lands, and wage tactical battles to expand your empire’s reach.
